replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
It'd be cool if you removed the two little islands in the middle so it's just 2 void gaps.
That way people might use the big figure 8 island more and gameplay could focus on the centre.

Other than that I really like it!

replies.body:
If I understand right, it is DTM map, and monuments are too close to spawns

If you make it less flat, it may become good KoTH or CTF map.
